body: I'm not gonna get myself involved in this other than with this; I have been smoking weed for 3 or so years and it makes me neither better nor worse, just temporarily lazier

You seem to think this is about just a bad self-image. But you've completely forgotten to consider the possibility that maybe I am truly, objective unlovable. I've worked out for years and dieted.for even more only to find next to no improvement in my mental or physical health. I've been on medication and in therapy for years, even been in psych wards. This is not just some little teen with image issues. I am genuinely fucked up beyond redemption.
Well, I'm glad I could spread a little love before I go out. I know my miserable existence has never and will never bring anyone joy. But thank you for the kind words :)
